name: watch-navigator-watch
description: Huawei Lite Wearable turn-by-turn navigation application (Watch GT5)

scripts.validate: tsc && node -e "import fs from 'fs'; const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('entry/src/main/config.json', 'utf8')); if (!config.module.deviceType.includes('liteWearable')) throw new Error('Invalid deviceType'); if (!config.module.reqPermissions?.some((p) => p.name === 'ohos.permission.VIBRATE')) throw new Error('Missing ohos.permission.VIBRATE permission'); if (!fs.existsSync('entry/src/main/resources/base/media/icon.png')) throw new Error('Missing icon.png'); const icons = ['turn_straight.png', 'turn_left.png', 'turn_right.png', 'turn_slight_left.png', 'turn_slight_right.png', 'turn_sharp_left.png', 'turn_sharp_right.png', 'turn_uturn.png', 'turn_roundabout.png', 'turn_depart.png', 'turn_arrive.png']; icons.forEach(icon => { if (!fs.existsSync('entry/src/main/resources/base/media/' + icon)) throw new Error('Missing media: ' + icon); if (!fs.existsSync('entry/src/main/js/default/common/' + icon)) throw new Error('Missing common: ' + icon); }); console.log('Lite Wearable TypeScript build, config & maneuver icon assets valid');"
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run validate

author: hungify
